summary: Change satisfies the contract in full. GuideContent combines keyword and category filtering with China-first labeling, source names on cards, and an actionable empty state; GuideArticleContent exposes source link, provider purpose, source-access date, content-review date, age range, and the fixed non-diagnostic disclaimer with a missing-item fallback. Future public-network providers are registered only, with explicit confirmation that V1 makes no browser-side calls and article copy remains reviewed local Mock content — so the no-diagnosis / no-live-call requirements hold. All quality gates are green: 21/21 tests across 8 files, tsc --noEmit, Vite production build, and scoped Biome. No P0 categories are implicated: no secrets or PII, no auth surface, no data destruction, no network egress from the browser.
